Point-transformed fixture is encoded at effective precision P-Pt with Pt=0, then SOF precision and SOS Pt are set to P and Pt. Residuals are identical by T.81 H.1.2.1. This avoids the reference encoder using an unshifted initial prediction for Pt>0.
